6284937.name: Chabad of Lincoln Square
6284937.note: COLlive, 16 May 2024 ('New Shluchim to Lincoln Square, Chicago'): 'Rabbi Choni and Shaina Hertz (nee Posner) have moved to Lincoln Square, Chicago, IL to establish the neighborhood's first permanent Chabad presence', appointed by Rabbi Baruch and Chanie Hertz of greater Lakeview and Rabbi Meir Shimon Moskowitz; 'The Hertz's are off to a great start, distributing over a hundred Matzahs to yidden for Pesach.' CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024: 'Rabbi Choni and Shaina Hertz at Chabad of Lincoln Square, IL' among the fifty new shluchim of the 100 new centres. Its chabad.org listing went up 25 Jan 2024. (Before them, Chabad of Lakeview held outdoor menorah lightings in Lincoln Square by 2018: JUF News, 2 May 2019.)

678345.name: Jewish Bradley Chabad
678345.note: COLlive, 24 Nov 2011 ('Celebrating a Decade in Peoria'): 'the Chabad Jewish Center of Peoria and Bradley University ... celebrated 10 years this past Sunday, November 20', at the Bradley Student Center Ballroom; a Bradley dean spoke of 'Rabbi Eli and Sarah Langsam, who have had such a significant impact in Peoria and at Bradley over the past ten years.' Jewish Bradley Chabad is a department of Chabad of Peoria (118486, 2001). Medium: counted back, and this department's own chabad.org listing only went up 21 May 2008.
